name: mStone Switch Spring gold plating spring 35g 40g 45g 50g 55g 60g 62g 67g 75g 80g Custom Cherry MX Gold Plated
sourceText:
Out of every switch component, the spring is perhaps the most instrumental in creating a switch’s individual feel. No matter what your preference is, mStone’s custom gold-plated switch spring line has the fine-tuned, high-performing feel you’re after. Durable and consistent, each spring is made from stainless steel and gold-plated for extra corrosion resistance. Available here are five spring styles—15-millimetre springs, 18-millimeter long springs, 22-millimeter extra-long springs, 23-millimetre symmetric long springs, and 20-millimeter dual-symmetric springs. Springs with the symmetric design feature a tighter mid coil, while dual-symmetric springs have two tight mid coils. Individually packaged in 70-count, 90-count and 110-count packs, all spring styles are available in a variety of weights ranging from 35 grams to 80 grams.

Material: Gold-plated stainless steel
Lengths: 15 mm, 18 mm, 22 mm, 23 mm (symmetric design), 20 mm (dual-symmetric design)

Domikey x GLOVE Tiger SA Profile ABS Doubleshot Keycaps
We are delighted to have the new design from GLOVE. This time, GLOVE combines Chinese culture into his design and work with Domikey on Tiger SA profile Keycaps. To celebrate the coming Chinese New Year - Tiger Year! Wish you all healthy and strong to fight with the pandemic!
Join KPRepublic discord server to follow SA Tiger process and get pre-discount.
GB CLOSED ON 24th December
Estimated Delivery March 2022
UPDATE 2022/1/10
GLOVE updates the design of the Keycap Package
ABOUT DESIGN
The figure of Tiger has a deeply and strong image in Chinese Folk custom. By adding rich culture meanings generation by generation, the image of tiger is simplified and symbolized by Chinese people for Exorcism and Benediction.
As Tiger is given an image and meaning as scaring away bad evils and guarding the house, Chinese people usually make their wares and articles with a tiger face. In Folk custom, the Tiger is treated as a Child guardian. Children wear tiger-head hats and shoes, sleeps on tiger pillows. Therefore, the image of Tiger is designed powerful and lovely. It carries people’s wish to their children that to grow up like tiger and keep healthy and strong.
Based on the above concept, GLOVE designs the tiger novelties like the following picture.

The above is the three colour used in design.
The yellow is close to the colour in SA 00 set by Domikey.
The white is close to the normal PBT warm white.
The coffee colour is close to the MOD kit colour in Chocolate theme keyset.
PLAYING WITH TIGER KEYCAPS
- Dual usages of 1.5u Keycap
Two 1.5u lucky cloud Novelties are able to use as Tab key and backslash key.
- TIGER-T Coffee Transparent keycap
The craft isn’t very clear in render image, the final keycap is similar to SA APES Black transparent keycap.
- Customize your Tiger gear
When you buy Yellow Tiger All in one or White Tiger All in one, you are able to combine and assemble two keyboards with different layouts.
The below is a group of Layout Samples. More layout groups waiting for your ideas.
KEYCAPS ON DIFFERENT LAYOUTS
As SA APES Keycaps, SA Tiger keycaps also has an associated switch that Kailh makes.
Kailh Amber Switch
Amber switch is linear switch sharing same module of KAILH MASTER switch series. The upper cover is PC plastic, the stem and the lower cover are POM plastic. The switch features long springs and its force weight designs to 45g. The final switch tech data and touch feeling will be updated when sample is produced.
